8_SECURITY_MISTAKE_I_MADE_AND_WHY_IT_IS_.what_happened: while debugging the Nostr signer I ran a diagnostic that printed repr() of data/nostr_key.json['seckey'] to the terminal.
8_SECURITY_MISTAKE_I_MADE_AND_WHY_IT_IS_.exposure_scope: terminal output in this session only. The value was NOT written to any file, NOT committed, and NOT sent anywhere.
8_SECURITY_MISTAKE_I_MADE_AND_WHY_IT_IS_.why_it_matters_anyway: a Nostr secret key is full authorship control of every event this factory has ever published. It should never have been rendered, even locally. The correct move - which I used for the actual publish - is bytes.fromhex(...) with no printing at all.
8_SECURITY_MISTAKE_I_MADE_AND_WHY_IT_IS_.action: not rotated, because rotation would require generating a new key, which would break continuity of the published event history, and that is a founder decision. Flagged rather than silently ignored.
